description: This file defines the interface for an rbus buffer management, including structure definitions, function prototypes for buffer creation, destruction, read/write operations, and TLV encoding/decoding. It primarily enables binary data handling for rbus messaging.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Create
methods.description: Initializes and allocates resources for an rbusBuffer
